implemented_requirements.requirement: Initialize 8x8 board with standard four starting discs
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.__init__ creates an 8x8 grid and reset() places the four discs at the centre (board.py lines defining reset()).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Validate candidate moves and detect flippable opponent discs in all eight directions
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.get_flippable_discs iterates over DIRECTIONS and returns discs to flip; Board.is_valid_move uses it (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Place a disc, flip captured discs, and reject illegal moves
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.place_disc calls get_flippable_discs, updates the grid, and returns None for illegal moves (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide current score (black and white disc counts)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Board.get_score tallies BLACK and WHITE cells and returns a dict (board.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect when the board is full
Alternate turns between two players (BLACK and WHITE)
Handle automatic pass when a player has no legal moves
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.pass_turn checks has_valid_move and _advance_turn implements pass logic (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Detect end of game when board is full or neither player can move
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game._advance_turn calls _end_game when board.is_full() or when both players lack moves (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Determine winner and expose final score
Graphical UI that renders the board, discs, legal‑move hints, and live scoreboard
implemented_requirements.evidence: ReversiGUI.draw_board, draw_disc, update_score, and related methods in gui.py render the board with tkinter.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Allow mouse clicks to place discs and show feedback for illegal moves
implemented_requirements.evidence: ReversiGUI.on_click translates clicks to Game.make_move and updates status label on failure (gui.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Show game‑over dialog with winner or draw information
implemented_requirements.evidence: ReversiGUI.check_game_over displays a messagebox with final result (gui.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Provide a way to start a new game
implemented_requirements.evidence: ReversiGUI.restart creates a fresh Game instance and refreshes UI (gui.py).

judge.summary: The submitted code implements a complete Reversi (Othello) game: board logic, move validation, disc flipping, turn management, pass handling, end‑game detection, scoring, and a functional Tkinter GUI with live updates and a new‑game option. All core requirements are satisfied, and the code appears syntactically correct and ready to run, yielding a passing verdict.
